labels.C: on another canvas the room weighs a venue, recruits, builds or places again
labels.S: the shared action itself sought again in another form (a song, a day of memes)
labels.M: the work remade by members in other media or for personal use (avatar, game, beads, bricks, a copypasta)
labels.E: the mark adopted into the room or its source (sidebar, flair, logo, an official colour)
labels.D: damage or an error in the mark kept as part of the emblem
labels.K: keepsakes sold, and the sale contested
labels.V: the event's venue or ties kept, or proposed, as standing community (a chat server, crossover threads)
labels.R: attack, loss or defence again on the successor canvas, or planned for
labels.X: a member doubts, objects to or declines the continuation
